sermon.title: Briefly Debate Truth With Liars 02/10/2019
sermon.speaker: Pastor David G. Kincer
sermon.summary: In part three of surviving tragedy, Pastor David G. Kincer shows that Job rightly rejected his friends’ lies but kept arguing until he accused God falsely. Elihu, who listened and spoke by the Spirit, corrected him. State truth briefly, avoid long debates, and remember that rejecting God’s word is sin against God Himself.
sermon.transcript_source: This transcript comes from YouTube’s automatic English captions, which supply the timing and the words. Punctuation, capitalization and paragraphing were added from the speaker’s pauses and then corrected by hand, and obvious caption errors (names, Bible references) were fixed; his wording was not rewritten. “[unclear]” marks a word or name that was not clear. Editor notes: Divorce statistic kept as spoken and not checked.

scriptures.text_nkjv: “I have made a covenant with my eyes; Why then should I look upon a young woman? For what is the allotment of God from above, And the inheritance of the Almighty from on high? Is it not destruction for the wicked, And disaster for the workers of iniquity? Does He not see my ways, And count all my steps? “If I have walked with falsehood, Or if my foot has hastened to deceit, Let me be weighed on honest scales, That God may know my integrity. If my step has turned from the way, Or my heart walked after my eyes, Or if any spot adheres to my hands, Then let me sow, and another eat; Yes, let my harvest be rooted out. “If my heart has been enticed by a woman, Or if I have lurked at my neighbor’s door, Then let my wife grind for another, And let others bow down over her. For that would be wickedness; Yes, it would be iniquity deserving of judgment. For that would be a fire that consumes to destruction, And would root out all my increase. “If I have despised the cause of my male or female servant When they complained against me, What then shall I do when God rises up? When He punishes, how shall I answer Him? Did not He who made me in the womb make them? Did not the same One fashion us in the womb? “If I have kept the poor from their desire, Or caused the eyes of the widow to fail, Or eaten my morsel by myself, So that the fatherless could not eat of it (But from my youth I reared him as a father, And from my mother’s womb I guided the widow); If I have seen anyone perish for lack of clothing, Or any poor man without covering; If his heart has not blessed me, And if he was not warmed with the fleece of my sheep; If I have raised my hand against the fatherless, When I saw I had help in the gate; Then let my arm fall from my shoulder, Let my arm be torn from the socket. For destruction from God is a terror to me, And because of His magnificence I cannot endure. “If I have made gold my hope, Or said to fine gold, ‘You are my confidence’; If I have rejoiced because my wealth was great, And because my hand had gained much; If I have observed the sun when it shines, Or the moon moving in brightness, So that my heart has been secretly enticed, And my mouth has kissed my hand; This also would be an iniquity deserving of judgment, For I would have denied God who is above. “If I have rejoiced at the destruction of him who hated me, Or lifted myself up when evil found him (Indeed I have not allowed my mouth to sin By asking for a curse on his soul); If the men of my tent have not said, ‘Who is there that has not been satisfied with his meat?’ (But no sojourner had to lodge in the street, For I have opened my doors to the traveler); If I have covered my transgressions as Adam, By hiding my iniquity in my bosom, Because I feared the great multitude, And dreaded the contempt of families, So that I kept silence And did not go out of the door— Oh, that I had one to hear me! Here is my mark. Oh, that the Almighty would answer me, That my Prosecutor had written a book! chunks.section_question: Why should every member study the word?
chunks.short_answer: So all can come to the unity of the faith and know whether a preacher tells the truth; every joint supplies, and those planted in the house of the Lord flourish.

Voices and you want to learn from Job and keep your debates brief. scriptures.text_nkjv: from whom the whole body, joined and knit together by what every joint supplies, according to the effective working by which every part does its share, causes growth of the body for the edifying of itself in love.
Those who are planted in the house of the LORD Shall flourish in the courts of our God.

faqs.question: Is there a Bible for each group?
faqs.answer: No; one Bible, one word, one God.

faqs.question: What does he credit Trump with?
faqs.answer: Causing China and Iran to back off.

faqs.question: Is the Bible a book of faith?
faqs.answer: He says it is a book of truth.

faqs.question: What did the empty glass illustrate?
Does God need our worship?
faqs.answer: No; it is for our good.

faqs.question: When did God give judgment to humans?
Does eating blood hurt anyone?
faqs.answer: Not directly, but it defies God.

faqs.question: Has he found true believers in every denomination?
faqs.answer: Yes, even in the Catholic church.
